pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal dark regions with moderate edge angularity and sharp pixel gradients. Spatial area of individual patches is greatest on the upper flank, becoming smaller and more fragmented on the neck and lower limbs.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of narrow, light-colored interstitial corridors with predominantly tri-radial junction nodes. Pixel thickness of these pathways is consistently thin, maintaining clear separation between adjacent patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A short, upright mane along the dorsal neck ridge exhibits a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: A small, dark silhouette is visible perched on the dorsal ridge just above the shoulder, consistent with the presence of an oxpecker (Buphagus).
